integrity: Proof of upper bound supplies eight explicit bilinear terms; lower bound uses full enumeration of 6435 possible seven-functional support sets and direct GF(2) row reduction; no independent validation performed.
limitations: Proved only over F_2 for n=1,2,3,4; no statement for larger n or different fields; historical small-field algorithm tables may have equivalent results.
title: The first binary excess for truncated-polynomial evolution envelopes
